items.item_text: A Bachelor’s degree in a related field and/or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
5 or more years of progressively responsible experience in contact center operations, patient support services, healthcare customer service or related field
2 or more years of supervisory or management experience leading staff in a contact center, customer service, patient support, or healthcare operations environment

As the MedGroup Contact Center Manager, you will lead contact center operations across multiple service lines under the direction of the Assistant Director. You will provide leadership and operational oversight to ensure patients, providers, and internal stakeholders receive responsive, accurate, and high-quality service.
Direct daily contact center operations to meet operational goals and established service standards.
Monitor performance metrics and implement workflow improvements to enhance efficiency and service quality.
Maintain an understanding of medical claims, including claim status, denials, adjustments, and member/provider inquiries
Manage, coach, and develop supervisors and contact center teams.
Promote a collaborative, service-focused work environment.
Ensure compliance with organizational policies and regulatory requirements.
Support continuous quality improvement initiatives.
We are looking for a leader with:
Able to effectively supervise, organize, schedule, prioritize, and direct staff activities and operational workflow
Knowledgeable of contact center operations, customer service techniques, performance metrics, quality assurance practices, and industry best practices

Familiarity with health plan processes, eligibility verification, benefit interpretation, National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA), and Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) standards
Ability to manage contact center performance metrics, productivity standards, service levels, and operational workflows to achieve departmental goals
Ability to analyze operational and financial data, identify trends, determine root causes, and implement effective process improvements
Knowledgeable of contact center technologies, telephony platforms, customer relationship management (CRM) systems, reporting tools, and workforce management applications.
Working knowledge of medical, insurance, patient access, and billing terminology, including healthcare operational workflows
Interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with patients, providers, health plans, vendors, management, and staff across diverse functional areas
Ability to communicate clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing, and to convey complex information to various audiences
Ability to coach, mentor, develop, motivate, and positively influence supervisors and staff to achieve operational and service objectives
Solid critical-thinking, decision-making, conflict resolution, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to evaluate complex situations and implement appropriate solutions
Knowledgeable of HR policies, performance management practices, employee development principles, and supervisory responsibilities
Working knowledge of HIPAA, privacy requirements, organizational policies, and applicable regulatory and accreditation standards
